package.name: Canvas demo
package.author: Peersus contributors
package.description: Draws a responsive field of 1,500 strokes and text in a desktop WASM extension.

exports.description: Draws and responds to the demo page.

page.description: Return the demo page and consume its interactions.

pages.title: Apache License 2.0
pages.explains: Use, change, and share the example under Apache-2.0, keeping its licence and notices.
pages.changes: The example runs as an extension; no data or device permissions are granted.

pages.title: What Canvas demo does
pages.explains: It draws synthetic strokes and text, and handles panning and zooming on its own page.
pages.changes: Nothing is collected, persisted or transmitted to another device.
